name: tuned-in-app
description: Tuned In — a flexible task board, running on Cloudflare Workers + D1.

scripts.dev:demo: node scripts/build-profile.mjs default && wrangler dev --env demo
scripts.dev:local: node scripts/build-profile.mjs local && wrangler dev --env demo
scripts.deploy:local: npm test && node scripts/build-profile.mjs local && wrangler deploy --env demo && npm run verify:local
scripts.build:demo: node scripts/build-profile.mjs default && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist
scripts.db:migrate:demo: wrangler d1 migrations apply tuned-in-demo --remote --env demo
scripts.db:migrate:local:demo: wrangler d1 migrations apply tuned-in-demo --local --env demo
scripts.db:migrate:all: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:migrate:demo
scripts.deploy:app: npm test && node scripts/build-profile.mjs default && wrangler deploy --env app && npm run verify:app
scripts.dev:app: node scripts/build-profile.mjs default && wrangler dev --env app
